fit is default (composed choice), fits, tight (measure first), or poor for this Mac.
cached is yes when the Hugging Face cache holds that preset's upstream repo
(every diffusers weight component with non-empty shards, or a complete single-file
layout, and no incomplete blob). Nothing is downloaded.

fit	cached	model	weights	use
default	no	flux2-klein-4b	4B, 4-bit or 8-bit	Floor image model; default through 18 GB and on every fanless Air
poor	no	z-image-turbo	8-bit, wants 24 GB+	Quality default on cooled 24 GB and up
poor	no	schnell	FLUX.1 schnell	Optional FLUX.1 path; not a composed default
